function cleanScriptContent(script)
    -- Suche den Anfang der Base Code Markierung
    local base_code_start = script:find("%-%-%[%[Object base code%]%]")
    
    if base_code_start then
        -- Schneide alles ab, was ab der Base Code Markierung kommt
        local cleaned = script:sub(1, base_code_start - 1)
        -- Optional: Trim whitespace am Ende
        cleaned = cleaned:gsub("%s+$", "")
        return cleaned
    else
        -- Kein Base code gefunden, Skript so belassen
        return script
    end
end

function cleanScriptsInWorld()
    local objects = getAllObjects()
    local count = 0

    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        local script = obj.getLuaScript()
        if script and script ~= "" then
            local cleanedScript = cleanScriptContent(script)
            if cleanedScript ~= script then
                obj.setLuaScript(cleanedScript)
                obj.reload() -- neu laden, damit Änderungen greifen
                count = count + 1
                print("[CLEAN] Skript von '" .. obj.getName() .. "' bereinigt.")
            end
        end

        -- Optional: Falls States & Anhänge ebenfalls bereinigt werden sollen,
        -- kannst du das hier analog ergänzen.
    end

    print("[CLEAN] Bereinigung abgeschlossen. " .. count .. " Skripte bereinigt.")
end

function onLoad()
    print("[CLEAN] Global Script geladen. Gib !clean im Chat ein, um alle Skripte zu bereinigen.")
end

function onChat(message, player)
    if message == "!clean" then
        print("[CLEAN] Starte Bereinigung der Skripte …")
        cleanScriptsInWorld()
        return false
    end
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 200,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 50,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.75, 0.3, -0.75},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 125,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Links klicken zum erhöhen, Rechts klicken zum verringern"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.4}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.4}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    30.964},
        {startBottom, -30.964},
        {startTop,    149.036},
        {startBottom, -149.036}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
				width = 175,
				height = 175,
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
isVisible = false

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.5, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 175,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Toggle Sichtlinien
----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    63.435},
        {startBottom, 116.565},
        {startTop,    -63.435},
        {startBottom, -116.565}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 180,
        height = 90,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Toggle Sichtlinien
----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    26.565},
        {startBottom, -26.565},
        {startTop,    153.435},
        {startBottom, -153.435}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
				width = 175,
				height = 175,
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 150,
        height = 100,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.8, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 120,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Links klicken zum erhöhen, Rechts klicken zum verringern"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 50,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.75, 0.3, -0.75},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 125,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Links klicken zum erhöhen, Rechts klicken zum verringern"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.4}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.4}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    30.964},
        {startBottom, -30.964},
        {startTop,    149.036},
        {startBottom, -149.036}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------

			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",

				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------

			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})

local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

    createButton()
end

        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------

	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

----------------------------------------------------

function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 180,
        height = 90,	
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Toggle Sichtlinien
----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    26.565},
        {startBottom, -26.565},
        {startTop,    153.435},
        {startBottom, -153.435}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

isVisible = false

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 180,
        height = 90,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Toggle Sichtlinien
----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    26.565},
        {startBottom, -26.565},
        {startTop,    153.435},
        {startBottom, -153.435}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 200,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 50,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.75, 0.3, -0.75},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 125,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Links klicken zum erhöhen, Rechts klicken zum verringern"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------

    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.4}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.4}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    30.964},
        {startBottom, -30.964},
        {startTop,    149.036},
        {startBottom, -149.036}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

    createButton()

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 100,
        height = 50,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.75, 0.3, -0.75},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 125,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Links klicken zum erhöhen, Rechts klicken zum verringern"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.4}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.4}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    30.964},
        {startBottom, -30.964},
        {startTop,    149.036},
        {startBottom, -149.036}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 200,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

-- Sichtlinien Toggle
		local isVisible = false

		-- Konfiguration
		local LINE_Y = 0.1
		local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
		local BASE_SIZE = 200
		local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
		local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
		local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Initialisierung
		----------------------------------------------------
		function onLoad()
			createButton()
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Button erstellen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function createButton()
			self.createButton({
				click_function = "toggleVision",
				function_owner = self,
				position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.6},
				width = 200,
				height = 200,
				icon = "arcsIcon",
				tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
				label = "",
				font_size = 1
			})
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sicht umschalten
		----------------------------------------------------
		function toggleVision()
			if isVisible then
				hideVision()
			else
				showVision()
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- 45° Rotation um Y
		----------------------------------------------------
		local function rotate45(p)
			return {
				p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
				p[2],
				p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
			}
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
		----------------------------------------------------
		function showVision()
			isVisible = true

			local scale = self.getScale()
			local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

			local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
			local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
			local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

			local lines = {
				{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
				{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
			}

			self.setVectorLines(lines)
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
		----------------------------------------------------
		function hideVision()
			isVisible = false
			self.setVectorLines({})
		end

    self.createButton({

        position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 180,
        height = 90,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    26.565},
        {startBottom, -26.565},
        {startTop,    153.435},
        {startBottom, -153.435}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 125,
        height = 125,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

    })

    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.4}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.4}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    30.964},
        {startBottom, -30.964},
        {startTop,    149.036},
        {startBottom, -149.036}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 150,
        height = 150,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 150,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
	isVisible = true

	local scale = self.getScale()
	local size = BASE_SIZE * scale.x

	local L = rotate45({-size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local R = rotate45({ size, LINE_Y, 0})
	local T = rotate45({0, LINE_Y, -size})
	local B = rotate45({0, LINE_Y,  size})

	local lines = {
		{ points = {L, R}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS },
		{ points = {T, B}, color = {1, 0, 0}, thickness = LINE_THICKNESS }
	}

	self.setVectorLines(lines)
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.4, 0.3, -0.8},
        width = 180,
        height = 90,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Toggle Sichtlinien
----------------------------------------------------
function toggleVision()
    if isVisible then hideVision()
    else showVision() end
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation um die Y-Achse
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotateY(p, angle)
    local a = math.rad(angle)
    local c = math.cos(a)
    local s = math.sin(a)
    return {
        p[1] * c - p[3] * s,
        p[2],
        p[1] * s + p[3] * c
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------
function showVision()
    isVisible = true

    -- Feste Linienlänge
    local lineLength = 200
    local endBase = {lineLength, 0, 0}

    -- Startpunkte (leicht anpassbar!)
    local startTop    = {0, 0,  0.5}
    local startBottom = {0, 0, -0.5}

    -- Winkel für ein diagonales Crosshair
    local angles = {
        {startTop,    26.565},
        {startBottom, -26.565},
        {startTop,    153.435},
        {startBottom, -153.435}
    }

    local lines = {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(angles) do
        local start = entry[1]
        local angle = entry[2]
        local rotatedEnd = rotateY(endBase, angle)

        table.insert(lines, {
            points = {start, rotatedEnd},
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            thickness = 0.05
        })
    end

    self.setVectorLines(lines)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien ausblenden
----------------------------------------------------
function hideVision()
    isVisible = false
    self.setVectorLines({})
end

isVisible = false
value = 0
MIN_VALUE = 0
MAX_VALUE = 30

-- Konfiguration
local LINE_Y = 0.1
local LINE_THICKNESS = 0.05
local BASE_SIZE = 200
local ROT_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local COS_A = math.cos(ROT_ANGLE)
local SIN_A = math.sin(ROT_ANGLE)


----------------------------------------------------
-- Initialisierung
----------------------------------------------------
function onLoad()
    createButton()
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- Button erstellen
----------------------------------------------------
function createButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "toggleVision",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {-0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        tooltip = "Sicht ein/aus",
        label = "",
        font_size = 1
    })

    -- Button für Zähler (hoch/runter mit Links-/Rechtsklick)
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 200,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })
end

-- Toggle-Funktion fehltet früher — hier ist sie:
function toggleVision(player_color, alt_click)
    if isVisible then
        hideVision()
    else
        showVision()
    end
end

-- Funktion für Links- (hoch) und Rechtsklick (runter)
function addSubtractCounter(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
end

function updateCounterDisplay()
    self.editButton({
        index = 1,           -- Zählerbutton ist der zweite Button (Index 1)
        label = tostring(value)
    })
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- 45° Rotation um Y
----------------------------------------------------
local function rotate45(p)
	return {
		p[1] * COS_A - p[3] * SIN_A,
		p[2],
		p[1] * SIN_A + p[3] * COS_A
	}
end
	
function incrementCounter()
	counter = counter + 1
	self.editButton({
		index = 1,           -- 0-basierter Index des Buttons (0 = erster Button)
		label = tostring(counter)
	})
end


----------------------------------------------------
-- Sichtlinien anzeigen
----------------------------------------------------

    })

    self.createButton({
        click_function = "addSubtractCounter",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0.6, 0.3, -0.7},
        width = 200,
        height = 200,
        label = tostring(value),  -- Anfangswert anzeigen
        font_size = 200,
        color = {1, 0, 0}, -- roter Button
        tooltip = "Wounds"
    })

        hideVision()
    else

    local new_value = math.min(math.max(value + mod, MIN_VALUE), MAX_VALUE)
    if value ~= new_value then
        value = new_value
        updateCounterDisplay()
    end
